description: This file declares the interface and factory for MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc, which is responsible for media pipeline capabilities communication via IPC in the Rialto client. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and references to external protobuf and IPC modules.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities over IPC, providing methods to get supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC client interface.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
